title: Investigate the Claude screen's bugs and bring it to parity with Claude Code
notes:
The Claude screen (Ctrl+Shift+A, from #83) has bugs found on first use. Investigate it end to end in the running app and fix what is broken.

Then close the gap with Claude Code: list every feature the Claude Code TUI has that this screen lacks, and build them. Known gaps from the #83 card: slash commands (skills like /pr-loop, /rebuild, /work-card must work), plan mode, the /resume picker.

This comes before moving the main and worker panes onto the chat view; that move only makes sense once the screen can do what the terminal does.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #86 (1.20.0). Fixed: an interrupted turn drawn as your own prompt; /clear leaving the screen and the next launch on the old conversation; raw <command-name> tags in read-back; the foot not following mode changes the session made itself. Added: slash command list, /resume search sheet, /plan and plan mode on Shift+Tab with plan approval, decline with a reason, prompt history. Still missing (needs cards): @ completion, ! bash mode, Ctrl+R, thinking, todo panel, subagent progress, queued prompts, /rename, MCP status, image drop.
